About us description: We are engineers who got tired of writing the same PLC structures by hand. So we build generators: software that takes over the repetitive part and leaves the engineering decisions to people. We connect industrial automation with .NET and modern web tooling.
About us point1: Industrial automation experience, not a software agency
About us point2: Your standard encoded once in a generator and reused in every project
About us point3: From input data to a TIA Portal project in one toolchain
Services description: Three things, one goal: less manual PLC work. We generate code, build the tools around the generator and program PLCs where an engineer's decision is still required.
ServiceGeneratorDesc: VASS6 PLC Creator and custom generators: input data becomes code ready to import into TIA Portal.
ServiceSoftwareDesc: Desktop and web applications around the generator — from preparing input data to importing the project.
ServicePlcDesc: PLC development when the generator is not enough: non-standard machines, integrations, fixes in existing code.
Platform title: All your tools in one place
Platform description: We are building a platform around our generators. One place to prepare input data, generate code, manage the library and import the result into TIA Portal. Custom generators and AI plug into the same workflow.
Platform tool1 description: Generator for the VASS6 standard. Input data in, TIA-ready project out.
Platform tool2 description: Your own generation rules in C# on top of TIA Portal Openness.
Platform tool3 description: Imports the generated package and builds the project structure automatically.
Platform tool4 description: Client-specific standards and conventions, designed and built with you.
Platform tool5 description: Logic suggestions based on requirements. Premium layer, in development.
Platform preview log3: ready to import into TIA Portal
Platform preview note: Real product screenshots coming soon. This frame is ready for them.
Cta description: Tell us what you need and we will propose a solution.
Products description: Tools we build and use every day to deliver PLC software faster and more reliably.
Product1 Description: Ready-to-use generator for PLC code in the VASS6 standard. Produces a project package ready for TIA Project Importer — and can be adapted to your process.
Product1 Description1: Speeds up the PLC writing process.
Product1 Description2: Better and more convenient form of programming.
Product1 Description3: Reduction of PLC program writing costs.
Product1 Description4: Improving the quality of logic within the standard.
Product1 Description5: Avoids the often and tedious process of copying and pasting and the associated errors.
Product1 Description6: Improving the quality of the PLC program.
Product1 Description7: Facilitating the management of the program languages (generating web titles and other texts in standardized forms).
Product1 Description8: Better management of know-how for a specific technology within the standard.
Product1 Description9: Facilitation of the programming process (reduction of required offline competencies).
Product2 Description: Static library written in .NET standard. Enables generating of the PLC program (LAD) in C# language.
Product2 Description1: Full support for TIA Portal Openness.
Product2 Description2: Set of tools for helping you with creating own generation rules.
Product2 Description3: Separate library for define/import production line structure.
Product2 Description4: Support for convert Tia Library from project to C# class format.
Custom description: VASS6 PLC Creator is our ready-to-use generator for PLC software in TIA Portal, built for the VASS6 standard. When your process needs something different, we can adapt it — or build a dedicated generator from scratch.
Custom card1 description: We tailor VASS6 PLC Creator to your naming conventions, templates and project structure. If the generated result is not exactly what you need, we refine the rules together with you. Need a generator for another PLC standard? We can design and build it with you.
Custom card1 bullet1: Custom rules, templates and project structure
Custom card1 bullet2: Support for other standards and client-specific workflows
Custom card1 bullet3: Built on PLC TIA .NET Library and TIA Portal Openness
